description: Drives a TP-Link Tapo bulb or light strip over the local network, using the encrypted KLAP protocol of current Tapo firmware (L510, L530, L535, L610, L630, L900, L920 and similar). Color and white range are read from the device.

config.name: Address
config.description: Address of the device on the local network, for example 192.168.1.50, optionally with a port. Without http:// or a path. Give the device a fixed address in the router, so it does not change.

config.name: Email
config.description: Email of the TP-Link account the device was set up with in the Tapo app

config.name: Password
config.description: Password of the TP-Link account used in the Tapo app

config.name: Refresh interval
config.description: How often the device status is read, in seconds. Set to 0 to read it only after a command.

config.name: Lowest color temperature
config.description: Lower end of the white range in kelvins, used when the device does not report its own

config.name: Highest color temperature
config.description: Upper end of the white range in kelvins, used when the device does not report its own

state.name: Exchange step
state.description: Which request is currently waiting for an answer, 0 when idle

state.name: Exchange started
state.description: Uptime in milliseconds when the pending request was sent, used to give up on a lost answer

state.name: Command pending
state.description: Set when a command arrived during another exchange and waits to be sent once it is over

state.name: Capabilities known
state.description: Set once the device has reported what it supports

state.name: Color supported
state.description: Whether the device can show colors

state.name: Device lowest color temperature
state.description: Lower end of the white range of the device in kelvins

state.name: Device highest color temperature
state.description: Upper end of the white range of the device in kelvins, equal to the lower end when the white is not adjustable

state.name: Requested power
state.description: Power state of the pending command

state.name: Requested color mode
state.description: Color mode of the pending command

state.name: Requested color temperature
state.description: Color temperature of the pending command

state.name: Last refresh timestamp
state.description: Last scheduled refresh in seconds from epoch

state.name: Next refresh timestamp
state.description: Next scheduled refresh in seconds from epoch
